In the following reaction :

Aldehyde + Alcohol     Acetal

Aldehyde                    Alcohol
HCHO tBuOH
CH3CHO MeOH

The best combination is

options.content: CH<sub>3</sub>CHO and MeOH
HCHO and MeOH
CH<sub>3</sub>CHO and tBuOH
HCHO and tBuOH

en.explanation:
In Formaldehyde (HCHO) both side of the C atom H presents but in Acetaldehyde (CH3CHO) one side of C atom -CH3 group and other side H atom presents. So Formaldehyde is less crowded then it is more reactive.

CH3OH is 1o alcohol and tBuOH is 3o alcohol. As we know on 3o alcohol steric hindrance is very high compare to 1o alcohol and due to steric hindrance reactivity of 3o alcohol is less compare to 1o alcohol.

en.explanation:
Among CH CH and CH2 = CH2, in CH CH compound H atom is attached with sp hybridised C atom and in CH2 = CH2 compound H atom is attached with sp2 hybridised C atom.

As we know, electronegitivity of sp carbon is more compare to sp2 carbon atom and that H is more acidic which is attached with more electronegative carbon atom. So CH CH is more acidic than CH2 = CH2.

Among CH CH and CH3–C CH, in CH CH both the H atom is connected to sp carbon atom but in CH3–C CH, with one sp carbon atom H atom attached and with other sp carbon atom -CH3 group attached which have +I effect and we know +I effect decreases acidic strength.
So, CH CH is more acidic than CH3–C CH.

So correct order is

HC CH > CH3 – C CH > CH2 = CH2

hi.explanation:
CH CH और CH2 = CH2 में से, CH CH यौगिक में H परमाणु sp संकरित C परमाणु से जुड़ा है और CH2 = CH2 यौगिक में H परमाणु sp2 संकरित C परमाणु से जुड़ा है।

जैसा कि हम जानते हैं, sp कार्बन की विद्युत ऋणात्मकता sp2 कार्बन परमाणु की तुलना में अधिक होती है और वह H अधिक अम्लीय होता है जो अधिक विद्युत ऋणात्मक कार्बन परमाणु से जुड़ा होता है। अतः CH CH, CH2 = CH2 की तुलना में अधिक अम्लीय है।

CH CH और CH3–C CH में से, CH CH में दोनों H परमाणु sp कार्बन परमाणु से जुड़े हैं, परन्तु CH3–C CH में एक sp कार्बन परमाणु से H परमाणु जुड़ा है और दूसरे sp कार्बन परमाणु से -CH3 समूह जुड़ा है जिसका +I प्रभाव है और हम जानते हैं कि +I प्रभाव अम्लीय सामर्थ्य को घटाता है।
अतः, CH CH, CH3–C CH की तुलना में अधिक अम्लीय है।

अतः सही क्रम है

HC CH > CH3 – C CH > CH2 = CH2

(B)

options.content: A < B < C < D
B < A < C < D
B < A < D < C

en.explanation:
Lone pair over nitrogen will act as the reacting centre and more free nitrogen atom will be more reactive towards alkyl halide.

For compound (A), lone pair of N atom is in resonance with bond of C = O. So lone pair of N atom gets delocalised.

For compound (B), lone pair of N atom is in resonance with bond of two C = O. So here lone pair of N atom gets more delocalised than compound (A). So reactivity towards alkyl halide is very less for this compound.

For compound (C), lone pair of N atom is in resonance with bond of benzene ring and bond of C N. So delocalisation of lone pair of N atom is relatively high.

For compound (D), lone pair of N atom is in resonance with bond of benzene ring only. So delocalisation of lone pair of N atom is relatively low.

Reactivity order is B < A < C < D.

en.content: The major product of the following reaction is
en.explanation:
Chlorine in adds across the terminal C=C, giving (Ar = 3-methoxyphenyl).

Anhydrous removes chloride from the secondary carbon, forming the more stable secondary carbocation ; the primary is not ionised.

The cation is attacked intramolecularly by the ring carbon ortho to the side chain (intramolecular Friedel–Crafts alkylation). The ring formed contains the two ring carbons and the three side-chain carbons, so it is five-membered (indane).

Of the two ortho positions, the one para to is strongly activated and unhindered; the one between the two substituents is sterically blocked.

The product is 1-(chloromethyl)-5-methoxyindane, with the group para to the new C–C bond and the group on the five-membered ring.

Hence, the correct option is (A).

प्रयोग पाँचवीं फेंक पर ठीक तब समाप्त होता है जब फेंक 4 और 5 दोनों चार हों और इससे पहले लगातार दो चार न आए हों।

फेंक 1 से 3 में एक भी चार न आने देने पर केवल मिलता है, जिसमें वे अनुक्रम छूट जाते हैं जिनमें पहले एक अकेला चार आया हो, जैसे 4, 1, 2, 4, 4.
